about.what: Every consumer tier for 16 AI/productivity services, US and GB, read from official pricing pages or the App Store In-App Purchases list for that country. Same format as docs/research/prices-2026-11.json.
about.replaces: US and GB rows in prices-2026-11.json for these services
about.amounts: amountMinor is cents (USD) or pence (GBP). Regular price after any trial or first-year/first-month deal.
about.taxes: US web prices exclude sales tax. UK prices and all App Store prices include VAT.

status.verified: Every plan in the row was read today from the official page in 'source' (or the pages listed in its note).

about.method: Websites read with Playwright (chromium) from a US cloud IP, clicking monthly/yearly toggles. App Store lists read from apps.apple.com/{cc}/app/id{ID} (Apple shows at most 10 items). Where a website shows US$ to a UK browser locale (Canva, Notion, Dropbox, Proton, Claude), the GB row uses the App Store GB list.
about.rowsWithoutGB: github-copilot and midjourney bill in US dollars everywhere; canva-pro and grammarly GB are in notChecked.

prices.note: Pro yearly is '$200 billed up front' ($17/month shown). Max = 5x Pro usage; Ultra = 10x Pro usage per week and no 5-hour limit. The page names the plan just 'Max' (no 'Max 5x' / 'Max 20x' any more; Ultra is the new top tier). Prices exclude tax. In the iPhone app Max is $124.99 and Ultra $249.99 (App Store US list).
